full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 38
Federal
Nepal
Daily Agenda
Parliament,
Wednesday, Ashad 31, 2083
1:00 PM
Letter from the Office of the President
1. The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter received from the Office of the President regarding the certification of bills.
Presentation of Annual Reports
2. On behalf of the Honorable Prime Minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda', the Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, will present:
(a) The Eighteenth Annual Report of the National Human Rights Commission (Fiscal Year 2081/082, from Shrawan to Ashad end).
(b) The Annual Report of the National Information Commission, Fiscal Year 2081/082.
(c) The Seventh Annual Report of the National Inclusion Commission, Fiscal Year 2081/082.
Management Work
3. The Honorable Finance Minister, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, will present a proposal for consideration of the 'Bill to Amend and Repeal Some Nepal Laws Related to Finance, 2083'.
Discussion and Ratification of Treaties
4. The Honorable Minister for Youth, Labour and Employment, Ramji Yadav, will present:
(a) A proposal for discussion in the House on the provisions of Protocol No. 29 of 2014 concerning the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 of the International Labour Organization.
(b) A proposal for the ratification of Protocol No. 29 of 2014 concerning the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 of the International Labour Organization.
(c) A proposal for discussion in the House on the provisions of the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (No. 81) of the International Labour Organization.
(d) A proposal for the ratification of the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (No. 81) of the International Labour Organization.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
